proof_body:
by
  intro f g a b hab hc hd
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hab.le) hc
  refine ⟨c, hc1, ?_, fun x hx => hc2 hx⟩
  rcases hc1.1.eq_or_lt with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h.symm
  rcases hc1.2.eq_or_lt with h' | h'
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h')
  refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
  have hloc : IsLocalMax f c := (hc2.on_subset Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self).isLocalMax (Ioo_mem_nhds h h')
  exact hloc.hasDerivAt_eq_zero (hd c ⟨h, h'⟩)
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (g x) x) → ∃ c ∈ Set.Icc a b, (c = a ∨ c = b ∨ g c = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ f c
